reason: R8 means nothing to me, but I find my plans on Instagram and just WhatsApp the venue or use their link in bio, so I don't see why I'd open a new app to book something I can already sort out in a DM. Unless the place we want is only on TROVE, the group will just do what we always do.
objection: Why not just pay at the door or WhatsApp the venue? It's another app to download for something that already works for us.
would_change_my_mind: If the venues I follow on Instagram put a TROVE link in their bio, or it let me book and split for my whole group of eight in one go, I'd use it.
